book.contentHint: Search for a book and every field is filled. Or just type it yourself.
book.title: Book title
book.subtitle: Author
book.subtitleHint: Sits under the title, like the artist on an album poster.
book.showSubtitle: Show the author under the title
book.releaseDateLabelHint: What the publication date is called on the poster. Leave empty for Published.
book.lengthLabelHint: What the page count is called on the poster. Leave empty for Length.
book.lengthHint: Optional. The poster prints e.g. “320 pages”.
book.lengthInvalid: Enter the page count as a whole number, for example 320.
book.quoteHint: A book search puts the book's first line here when it is known. You can also write your favorite quote. Lines from books are usually protected by copyright, so without permission they are for a private poster only.
book.summaryHint: A book search puts the plot from Wikipedia or Open Library's description here, shortened to a few sentences. Wikipedia text is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0, descriptions may be publishers' blurbs. For a published or sold poster, the terms of use apply.
book.previewEmptyHint: Set a title and the chapters, and the preview shows up here.
book.qrHint: Where the poster's QR code points. The book's Wikipedia article or Open Library page by default; clear it to remove the QR code.

bookSearch.placeholder: Search for a book or author …
bookSearch.title: Search books
bookSearch.description: Books from Open Library, completed with Wikidata and Wikipedia. Chapters come from editions that recorded their table of contents.
bookSearch.note: The search uses Open Library, Wikidata and Wikipedia and only takes text from them: title, author, chapters, characters and plot. It never loads images. More in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
bookSearch.sources_wikipedia: Work, editions, chapters and publisher: <openlibrary>Open Library</openlibrary>. Title, characters, genre, series and first line where known: <wikidata>Wikidata</wikidata> (CC0). Plot: <wikipedia>Wikipedia, “{{title}}”</wikipedia>, <license>CC BY-SA 4.0</license>.
bookSearch.sources_openlibrary: Work, editions, chapters and publisher: <openlibrary>Open Library</openlibrary>. Title, characters, genre, series and first line where known: <wikidata>Wikidata</wikidata> (CC0). Summary: <description>Open Library</description>'s description, often a publisher's blurb.
bookSearch.sources_none: Work, editions, chapters and publisher: <openlibrary>Open Library</openlibrary>. Title, characters, genre, series and first line where known: <wikidata>Wikidata</wikidata> (CC0). No summary was found.
bookSearch.replaceHint: Both options refill title, author, date, pages, info, chapters, characters, works, first line and summary. Whatever you changed there yourself is gone afterwards.
